investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helus Travel (travel booking); Platform: Google Cloud us-central1 (zones us-central1-a/us-central1-b/us-central1-c/us-central1-f); network range 10.46.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster helus-prod-uscent (GKE); Billing: a daily charge job 'premium-collection' is triggered by the in-house scheduler 'chronos-lite', which computes run times from local wall-clock time (Europe/Madrid); charges go through payment-gw to an external card processor; job executions are recorded by job name; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
